item.title: [6.1] TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents.

WHY IT MATTERS

TARSphere presents a comprehensive full-stack framework and benchmark for evaluating long-horizon embodied agents in dynamically evolving physical and social environments, though its practical impact depends on community adoption.
